summary.text: Susan Fischer-Maki is the Democratic candidate for the Oregon House of Representatives, District 3, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Dwayne Yunker (R).
Ballotpedia lists her as a former member of the Three Rivers/Josephine County School District board, Zone II, who assumed office in 2022.
